v5_tb.title: v5 + shallow-K tie-break
mechanisms: kernel pipeline per K step
shared DRAM / interleaved-L1 bandwidth
burst congestion (all reads)
per-receiver mcast ack
spill/reload inside compute

v5_argmin.title: v5, plain argmin
mechanisms: as v5_tb

v6.title: v6: link load + measured constants
mechanisms: v5 pipeline
NoC max-link load per K step (nocload.py, harvest-aware WH placement)
DRAM efficiency pinned to measured 0.77
launch pinned to profiled 0.5 us
spill re-init + fp32 unpack-to-dest cost from the K-step profile
burst congestion on interleaved-L1 reads only

v7.title: v7: saturation, bank camping, per-page issue
mechanisms: v6 pipeline and link load
read latency hidden once shared bandwidth saturates (sat)
DRAM bank camping per K step (bank, bankload.py)
per-page read issue cost on the reader core (issue)
2D fused-batch row cores
Reuse batch-scale blocks; MultiCore tile bytes + DRAM limit
consolidated: no flags, ablatable terms, per-arch pinned constants

v8.title: v8: partial-K zero fill
mechanisms: v7
in0 reader zero-fills the last K tile of every row when K % 32 != 0 (pad, 4.4 cycles/element on WH)
BH harvested layout from bh-30 (columns 7 and 10)
nocload fused-batch rows

v9.title: v9: mcast ack sync
v9.constants: fitted_v7_wh.json / fitted_v7_bh.json at bf6978e (frozen as frozen_v9_*.json)
mechanisms: v8
mcast receivers ack only after computing on a block, so the sender's ack collection (receivers x ack_rx) sits on every compute-bound K step (msync)

v10.title: v10: measured constants
v10.constants: fitted_v7_wh.json / fitted_v7_bh.json at a9fbdc9 (frozen as frozen_v10_*.json)
mechanisms: v9
multicast data at its own measured rate, falling with receivers (mcrate)
WH lat_dram, lat_l1, issue, noc_eff, mc_eff0, mc_eff_rx pinned from data-movement microbenchmarks (10 of 22 WH constants measured)

v11.title: v11: miss-sweep training + loaded read rate
mechanisms: training adds the full sweeps of draw 1 (59 problems) and of the draw-2 problems v6 missed (41)
a core reading DRAM while other cores also read gets the loaded per-core rate, 0.48 of 32 B/cycle (corecc, measured with 4 concurrent readers)

v12.title: v12: calibrated fit
v12.constants: fitted_v7_wh.json / fitted_v7_bh.json at dbc5f7a (frozen as frozen_v12_*.json)
mechanisms: fit weighs the absolute log error at 0.5 (was 0.2) next to the within-problem error: predicted times stay calibrated, ranking unchanged

v13.title: v13: sharded handoff + MultiCore candidate
v13.pick: argmin over enumerated + rules' pick + one MultiCore candidate
mechanisms: sharded in0: the mcast sender rotates to the core holding each K slice, a handoff per step (shardhop, 279 cycles on WH)
training adds the full sweep of 110 sharded-input problems
pick offers the non-reusing MultiCore factory, which the enumerator never proposes

v14.title: v14: output dtype + precision rule
v14.pick: as v13, plus the precision validity rule
mechanisms: output dtype defaults to in0's when the op names none (as ttnn does): fixes write and spill bytes for bfp8/fp32 inputs
validity rule: bfp8/bfp4 partials without fp32 or L1 accumulation keep <= 32 spill round trips (pcc failures: 1/128 below, 31/32 above 64)
